notes.title: Update before the Demo live v0.0.7
notes.notes:
Here are the following updates:
[list]
[*] Day 3 in total. 2 candidates each turn.,
[*] second and third turn will have 2 Quest each,
[*] New title screen bg
[*] New settings ui to handle resolution, fullscreen, volume,
[*] UI Dashboard to display multiple panel (e.g., Employee, Quest, Storage, Settings),
[*] New dialog for both Gramps and Advisor before initiating a quest,
[*] New dialog during the Financial report,
[*] Fix multiple bugs that been found during playtest # 1,
[*] Rebalancing gramps on quest turn 1.
[*] Improved UI Storage, Finance
[*] New UI Dashboard
[/list]
